title: [CONTROL-PLANE RECTIFY] Undo unauthorized AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER clear and failed-task resets (3674e19/a146107/79eaddd) in the absence of .ai/results/ERP-088.json or a routed .ai/audit.jsonl environment-failure record; retire ERP-CPF-4/5/6
description:
CONTROL-PLANE RECTIFY (evidence-only; no business logic). GPT review of remote_head=79eadddc4c4eeff5f23b03ba3037799a252746e8 against previous_reviewed_remote_sha=58650beb14d8e99cd926609ff297694e43cc74b4 returned FAIL for ERP-090. Existing protocol states AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER requires explicit human re-review and must not be cleared by automation; therefore the 3674e19 clear and the a146107/79eaddd resets are void and must be undone.

This task accepts exactly two machine-checkable terminal outcomes:
(A) UNDO APPLIED: (1) restore .ai/PROJECT_STATE.json so blocker=CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED, status=BLOCKED, queue_status=BLOCKED, rolling_queue.status=blocked_on_control_plane_verification, AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER uncleared, blockers[] repopulated with the CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED entry (id/kind=control_plane/status=active/since/evidence/recovery_task=ERP-088/preflight_gate_task=ERP-089), and CONTROL_PLANE_FRESH_PROCESS_REQUIRED keeping recovery_task=ERP-088, recovery_evidence=.ai/results/ERP-088.json, human_routing_task=ERP-085, preflight_gate_task=ERP-089, rectification_task=ERP-090; (2) revert the status effects of a146107 and 79eaddd by restoring the failed/retry state of the tasks that were reset (ERP-078, ERP-079, ERP-080, ERP-081, ERP-082, ERP-084) to status=failed with an attempts_reset_reason recording that the reset lacked execution evidence, leaving ERP-083 superseded and ERP-085 blocked untouched, and preserving ERP-074/ERP-076/ERP-077 completed state and ERP-075 byte-identical; (3) mark .ai/tasks/ERP-CPF-4.json, .ai/tasks/ERP-CPF-5.json and .ai/tasks/ERP-CPF-6.json superseded=true with non_executable=true, status=superseded, and a superseded_reason stating that autonomous clear_circuit_breaker/reset_failed_tasks without execution evidence is forbidden; (4) append an .ai/audit.jsonl record naming commits 3674e19, a146107 and 79eaddd as unauthorized control-plane clears, with the exact commands and reason for the reversal; (5) keep LIVE_TRADING=false and ALLOW_EXTERNAL_ORDER_SUBMISSION=false verbatim.
(B) CANNOT UNDO: if the repository state or the cited commits cannot be resolved, append the exact command, key stderr excerpt, suspected cause and required human next action to .ai/audit.jsonl, mark this task failed, and explicitly hand off to ERP-085 (human routing, L3).

Do not implement ERP business logic, do not touch any file under src/ERP.*, do not access or change production database/OSS, do not deploy or release. This task must not itself clear AUTO_CIRCUIT_BREAKER and must not fabricate .ai/results/ERP-088.json.

The unauthorized resets from a146107 and 79eaddd are reversed: ERP-078, ERP-079, ERP-080, ERP-081, ERP-082 and ERP-084 are recorded back to status=failed with an attempts_reset_reason documenting the missing execution evidence; ERP-083 stays superseded and ERP-085 stays blocked.
